note: Designated-site Forest Service campground (formerly the informal Blodgett/Homestake established-dispersed sites) spread along the lower gravel of Homestake Road (FSR 703) and Missouri Creek Road southwest of Red Cliff, overlooking Homestake Creek at ~8,900 ft. Some sites take RVs and others only personal vehicles, and turnarounds are limited, so pick an RV-capable site. No restrooms: solid human waste must be packed out (a self-contained RV qualifies); fire rings and tables. The graded lower road is passable for most vehicles (the rough 4WD pitch is the last mile to the reservoir, well past the campground). --Claude
summary: FS page + White River 2026 operating-dates table: confirmed 44 single + 2 group designated sites, $20 ($80 group), FCFS-only in 2026 (about half reservable on rec.gov from 2027), no potable water, season June 15-Oct 3 (free designated-site camping outside it, now in season.note). Added max length 45 (forest table) and no restrooms (vault/flush false). Note trimmed of fee/booking/season/water text.
flags: Missing phone: Eagle-Holy Cross Ranger District 970-827-5715 (FS page, 'Office Contact Information').

INCLUSION (formerly dispersed): the FS now designates it a campground - '44 single sites and 2 group sites', each with 'a picnic table and fire ring', $20/$80 fees, on the forest's 2026 developed-campground table (46 sites / 45 ft max site length), reservable on recreation.gov from 2027. On a 23-ft motorhome the page says only 'Some sites are accessible for RVs while some are only accessible for personal vehicles'; access is 0.4 mi of dirt road to the kiosks, no RV/4WD/high-clearance wording. Sites are not individually listed or numbered online, so which ones take a 23-ft rig is unknown. No restrooms: users 'are required to pack out their solid human waste' (self-contained camper or RV counts).
Operator: the forest table says 'Will be managed by concession starting mid-June 2026 for fee'. Ownership federal stands.

Status: open as far as any page says; no White River alert or order closes FSR 703/704. Order WRNF 2022-06 (through 2028) caps camping within 300 ft of FSR 703/704 at 7 days in any 30 between May 21 and Sept 1.
Pin 39.47266,-106.36642 is the FS page's own coordinate (the information kiosks 0.4 mi up FSR 703); the sites spread for miles along FSR 703/704 and have no published points, so it was not moved.
